# Higgsfield Joins Anthropic as a Launch Partner for Linked Billing

Higgsfield

6 min

![](https://higgsfield.ai/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=webp,onerror=redirect,width=1920,quality=85/https://cdn.sanity.io/images/s479xw3z/production/b3dfb381e0e14150b8746a46ac2aa06575d81cc9-2720x1530.png)

On November 17, 2026, Anthropic announced Higgsfield as its launch partner for linked billing in beta on the Claude Platform. Eligible customers on Higgsfield Team, Scale, and Enterprise plans can connect their Claude Platform organization to Higgsfield and have supported Claude API usage in Supercomputer billed directly to that organization by Anthropic.

## What Was Announced?

Higgsfield is among the first partners to support Anthropic’s linked billing, enabling direct billing for supported Claude API usage in Supercomputer.

> “Our customers look to Claude for agentic capabilities in the tools they use to create. Linked billing lets them link their Claude Platform organization to Higgsfield, with Claude API usage billed directly to their organization. Operational simplicity lets their creative teams focus on what they do best.”

## How Do We Build With Anthropic?

Claude helps power agentic workflows in Higgsfield Supercomputer. It turns creative briefs into scripts, shot plans, and editing instructions that guide generation with Higgsfield’s image and video models.

Ramp is among the companies already using Higgsfield to create AI-generated visuals.

> “Higgsfield is helping us push our creative ideas further with AI-generated visuals. With linked billing, we can use Claude in Higgsfield through our own Claude Platform organization to build on that and scale our output across imagery and video.”

Linked billing makes it easier for teams to use Claude within their existing creative workflows while managing Claude API spending through Anthropic.

## What Does It Mean for Enterprise Teams?

Linked billing simplifies Claude API billing, while Higgsfield’s existing Enterprise features support team collaboration and credit management.

What Does It Mean for Enterprise Teams?

| What Teams Get | How It Works |
|---|---|
| Claude through their own organization | Connect Claude Platform organization to Higgsfield and have Claude API usage in Supercomputer billed directly by Anthropic. Image and video generations continue to use Higgsfield credits. |
| Simpler operations | Connect Claude Platform organization without sharing API keys. Anthropic bills supported Claude API usage directly. Teams can view spending, manage monthly limits, and unlink Higgsfield through Claude Console. |
| Built for production at scale | Higgsfield Enterprise plans offer unlimited seats, shared workspaces, sub-workspaces for collaboration, and credit pooling across teams. |
| Security and privacy assessments | Higgsfield has completed its SOC 2 Type II audit and an independent assessment of its compliance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Read more in our SOC 2 Type II and GDPR announcement |

## **How Can Teams Get Started?**

Linked billing is now available in beta on the Claude Platform. Higgsfield customers on Team, Scale, and Enterprise plans can connect their Claude Platform organization in a few steps:

1. Go to Manage Account → Workspace settings → Claude.
2. Click "Link your Claude organization."
3. An Owner, Admin, or Billing administrator of the Claude organization approves the connection and sets a monthly spending limit.
4. Return to Higgsfield and confirm that the connection status shows "Linked."

To learn more about linked billing, read [Anthropic's official announcement](https://claude.com/resources/articles/linked-billing-on-claude-platform).

For questions about Higgsfield Enterprise, visit [higgsfield.ai/enterprise](https://higgsfield.ai/enterprise).
